reflexion_entries_to_archive.lesson: The re-audit of a fix round found the fix had removed most of the measured cost — a border bug masqueraded as the intended intercept behaviour. Pin measured numbers as assertions, not prints.

An owner ruling that reads 'for every blast' had to be enumerated mechanically — a census keyed on BOMB_EXPLODE found every producer, and the auditor still named the one it cannot see (the Ra column).

The owner's reason for a rule (lag) is a requirement the rule must be measured against: the trickle stopped bursts but the audit's peak-live measurement (945 pants, 176 KB) showed it did not stop lag until a cap landed.
A train of eight merges with unit gates between each and ONE e2e on a fresh server shipped cleanly; the only e2e reds of the night came from a stale/overloaded environment, proven by the fresh run.
